== English Decipher-era comparison ==
The comparison records the complete English text printed on the original Bog-wing, the complete replacement wording in Decipher's Glossary Supplement (updated 29 January 2002, page 2), and the later Players Committee wording in Appendix A of the 2023 Advanced Rulebook (page 105). The Supplement's leading-marker and spacing typography is preserved; typography alone is not presented as a gameplay change.

The [[Bog-wing (Revised)|Revised article]] remains separate in Versions and is not an additional comparison column. Its displayed image and corresponding lore are preserved on that article; the image alone does not establish the authenticity of a physical edition. The original and PC faces retain destiny 5, ferocity *, flight 2, deploy 2 and forfeit 0; no additional attribute change is asserted. Highlights identify changed wording, leaving shared words and the shared distance instruction uncolored.

The original printed face supports FLIGHT 2. Joshua Lynch's archived Decipher strategy explicitly describes the Bog-wing + Bog-wing combo as selective creatures, so that historical classification is retained. The current PC data lists parasite, but that later record does not establish the classification for the Original wording. The unsupported Original parasite bullet was removed without asserting that the original card was not a parasite. The supported current PC classification remains unchanged.
